findings.criteria: Apply online 19 Oct to 9 Nov 2026; cut-off date 30 Sep 2026. Education: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Electrical and Electronics, or Electronics and Communication, or equivalent; or M.Sc (Statistics or Computer Science), MA (Statistics), M Stat or MCA. Individual-contributor experience does not count toward senior leadership. Age: 35 to 50 (as read from the advertisement table).
